NO circular O-mouths or protruding tongues; vary crooked closed smile, flat sag, clenched grin, uneven open laugh and underbite instead.

TRUE transparent alpha in all empty spaces and holes; NO background/gradient, scenelet, scenery, floor, shadow disc, painted checkerboard, text/numbers/labels/logos/captions/borders.
